topic: A PRO services firm scaled from 15 to 60 client companies without adding admin headcount
format: Lead with a specific customer outcome — time saved, errors eliminated, hours recovered — then describe what changed
post:
Four admin staff. Sixty client companies. Zero additional hires.

A PRO services firm in Oman pulled that off after moving everything off spreadsheets and into SmartPRO Hub.

Each client got its own white-label portal. Deadlines triggered automatically. Government filing checklists stopped living in someone's WhatsApp thread.

Four people handling what used to take eight — not because anyone worked longer hours, but because nothing fell through the cracks anymore.
